summary.text: Roger Victory of Hudsonville is a Republican member of the Michigan Senate representing District 31, which includes portions of Ottawa and Allegan counties.
His Senate biography says he was elected in 2018 to the 30th District, then reelected after redistricting to the 31st, and previously served six years in the state House.

paragraphs.text: Victory owns Victory Farms LLC, a year-round specialty crop producer, and Victory Sales LLC, a national produce distributor; he previously co-owned a trucking company from 1996 to 2004.
He graduated from Davenport University in 1989 with a degree in business management and from Michigan State University's Great Lakes Leadership Academy.
Before the Senate he represented the 88th District in the Michigan House of Representatives for six years.
In the Senate he previously chaired the Judiciary and Public Safety Committee and the Appropriations Subcommittees on Agriculture and Rural Development and on General Government.
He is Midwest chair for the National Council of State Governments, an executive board member of the Michigan Vegetable Council and a former president of the Ottawa County Farm Bureau.
He is a fourth-generation Hudsonville-area resident and a lifelong member of First Hudsonville Christian Reformed Church.
